title: unified-rollouts: conditional weighted canary + auto-rollback policy refinements
author: Sofia Mitchell
description: Motivation: Improve model rollout fidelity by allowing conditional weighted canary policies (weighting that changes based on runtime signals) and refine the auto-rollback decision engine to reduce false positives. This PR adds a first-pass implementation of conditional weighting rules, integrates them into the unified rollout evaluator, and tightens the rollback quorum and hysteresis logic to avoid flapping. Key design goals: 1) Support weight schedules that depend on observed latency/error windows; 2) Maintain deterministic, auditable rollback decisions (composite metric quorums + cooldown); 3) Preserve backwards compatibility with existing canary/AB/shadow configs. Changes: - Add new policy type ConditionalWeightedCanary with JSON schema + validation; - Extend rollout evaluator to evaluate runtime signals (latency p95, error-rate, token-quality-regressions) and compute dynamic weights; - Implement cooldown and hysteresis windows in the AutoRollback engine; - Add composite-quorum matcher to require either metric-majority or a super-threshold on a single critical metric; - Wire new metrics into observability (rollout.decisions.*, rollout.weights.*) and add dashboard snippets. Commits (summary): - feat(rollouts): add ConditionalWeightedCanary policy and schema (Sofia) - feat(engine): integrate runtime signal fetch + weight computation (Sofia) - fix(autorollback): add cooldown/hysteresis and quorum matcher (Maya) - test(rollouts): add unit + integration tests for conditional weighting (Ravi) - docs: update rollout policy reference and examples (Sofia) Files changed (high level): rollouts/policies/conditional_weighted_canary.py (+240 -6); rollouts/evaluator/evaluator.py (+140 -32); rollouts/autorollback/engine.py (+210 -48); rollout-migrations/v2_to_v3.md (+60 -0); observability/metrics/rollout_metrics.yaml (+28 -0); rollout-tests/test_conditional_weighted_canary.py (+120 -2); docs/rollouts/policies.md (+22 -2); examples/conditional-weighted-canary.yaml (+10 -0). Testing & CI: local unit tests (pytest) and integration canary simulation added; CI matrix ran on linux/py3.10 and linux/py3.11; all checks passed after second pipeline run (one transient infra failure retried). Checklist: [x] Unit tests added/updated; [x] Integration canary simulation; [x] Metrics emitted and dashboard notes; [x] Migration notes for v2->v3 rollout schema; [x] Backwards compatibility smoke test. Rollout plan and safety: will enable the policy behind the feature flag rollout. Initial rollout will be staged: 1) internal dev org only; 2) 10% production traffic with strict rollback thresholds; 3) gradual expansion if no regressions. Auto-rollback tuning: default configuration uses composite-quorum: require 2/3 metric voters OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive windows; hysteresis cooldown of 10 minutes post-rollback to avoid immediate re-deploys. Observability: added rollout.decisions.evaluated, rollout.weights.computed, rollout.alarms.triggered; updated console dashboard to show conditional weight curves. Migration: existing canary configs without the new policy remain unaffected. Documentation: added schema and examples. Related: ENG-2319 (policy work), ENG-2401 (rollback stability), SUP-8742 (customer reported flapping rollback during incident).
